Do you provide warranty or maintenance service?
Yes. We provide a standard warranty of 1 Year on general fit-out works and can offer maintenance packages to ensure long-term performance.
Are your designs compliant with local UAE rules and regulations?
Absolutely. All our projects strictly follow Dubai Municipality, Civil Defense, DEWA and relevant UAE authority regulations.
Do you guarantee project delivery timelines?

Yes. We commit to contractual delivery dates, with structured planning to meet deadlines. Also we do have financial responsibilities in front of the client in case of Contractor fault delays happened at project.
What services does Crystal Fit Contracting offer?
We provide end-to-end design and build solutions: commercial interiors, Food & Beverage (F&B), retail, offices, and Residential sectors.
How do I get started with Crystal Fit?
Simply contact us with your project requirements. Our team will schedule a free consultation and site assessment.
Can you help me select the right unit for my business?
Yes. We assist clients with site selection by evaluating size towards requirements, unit structure, MEP capacity, and complexity of third party approvals and construction processes at selected venue.
How do I ensure the project stays within budget?
We provide transparent BOQs, material specifications, contract agreement that clearly identifying inclusions and exclusions of contractors scope.
Do you handle authority approvals in Dubai?
Yes. We manage all drawings and approvals, Landlord approval, Dubai Civil Defence (DCD), DEWA, DDA,DHA, (DM) Dubai Municipality, Trakhees and other relevant authorities.
Can you work in Emaar, Dubai Holding, TECOM, or other developer projects?
Yes. We are experienced with leading developers’ standards and have successfully delivered projects in all major Malls and/or Landlords.
Do you offer design-only or build-only services?
Yes. We can provide full turnkey design & build, or standalone design/build services depending on your needs.
